I would point out parking lot as first. We have great place for parking in front of Jedlikova 9, I understand that such parkings can make money for dormitory but I dont really understand why would u make half of parking billable. This half of parking is empty for most of the time, so definitely the price is either to high, or there are not as much people willing to pay for parking in general as u expected. I would suggest you to either lower the price of paid parking spots or lower the number of paid parking spots. Also please mark paid parking spots so we know where not to park. 

The best solution would be to only mark paid spots, or employee reserved spots with some sort of signs, and any other spots would be considered as free, until someone pay the reservation for them.
